name: risk-matrix
description: Classic likelihood × impact risk matrix for a supplied set of risks. Assigns qualitative likelihood (rare / unlikely / possible / likely / almost-certain) and impact (negligible / minor / moderate / major / catastrophic), computes risk score and level (low / medium / high / critical), plots the heat map, and recommends response type (accept / reduce / transfer / avoid) per cell. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
